title: FAQ: Platinum Plus Account
summary: This document’s FAQs for the Platinum Plus Account state you earn 7.0% APY, must maintain a $100,000 minimum balance, and pay a $50.00 monthly maintenance fee if you don’t. It also notes wire transfer fees are waived and concierge travel services are included.
faqs: What APY do I earn on my balance in the Platinum Plus Account?
What is the minimum balance required for the Platinum Plus Account?
What monthly maintenance fee applies if I don’t meet the minimum balance?
Are wire transfer fees waived for this account?
Does the Platinum Plus Account include concierge travel services?
